verdict.rationale: Superset isolates agents in separate Git worktrees and branches. Its own docs say worktrees 'do not sandbox processes', and nothing documents a sandbox environment that keeps agents away from production data. The founder's note that user-defined setup/teardown scripts can 'spin up branching services' is a user-side building block, not a sandbox capability Superset ships, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
